text:
morgan: monitoring alerted to a spike in TLS handshake failures to api.pool-1 and shows a cert expiring in ~9d for internal api.redwood-inference.internal. Can infra/security confirm rotation plan + whether our logs are leaking any TLS secrets (session ticket keys, raw client ciphers) ? cc @ine @julia

ine: saw the alert, thanks. Rotation for that cert was scoped in INF-4510 but I don't have the owner for the session-ticket KMS alias. Security quick checks: 1) do we log $ssl_session or session ticket material anywhere? 2) minimum TLS version enforced? :eyes:

julia: infra update — nginx currently writes `$ssl_protocol $ssl_cipher` into access logs via our common vhost template. That exposes cipher strings (not secrets) but could be used for fingerprinting. We do not log session ticket contents anywhere on disk AFAIK. Staging still has raw client IPs in long-term logs; prod pipeline hashes IPs prior to retention. I'll prepare a small change to stop logging `$ssl_cipher` and add a redact step for staging.

sam: quick ops checks — to confirm endpoint negotiation you can run:
```
curl -sI --tlsv1.2 https://api.redwood-inference.internal | head
openssl s_client -connect api.redwood-inference.internal:443 -tls1_2
```
Also the session ticket key rotation is backed by a KMS alias `rwd/session-tickets` — who is the owner for that alias? @morgan?

morgan: yep I own `rwd/session-tickets`. Plan: rotate key during a low-traffic window next Tue 03:00 UTC, blow-forward only, and update all servers to fetch new tickets after rotation. I'll open the infra PR and schedule the rotation job. Security: do we need an SLA exemption or any extra approvals?

ine: security approves the rotation window. For the logging change: redaction is approvable by security (no legal needed) as long as retention policy doesn't change. If you shorten retention we need Ops+Legal notice.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4523 for scheduled rotation, runs 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z, job id job-98123. Notifying on completion channel.

julia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2134 — removes `$ssl_cipher` from access template and adds a logfilter that hashes client IPs for staging. I'll roll to staging tomorrow and watch for any regressions. Tagging @sam for rollback playbook.

sam: ack. Rollback: feature-flag the template change + keep previous log path until we see zero unredacted entries in the pipeline for 24h. Also alert if handshake-failures spike > 3x during rotation window.

morgan: thanks — I'll post a follow-up here once rotation completes and share verification steps (curl/openssl checks + KMS key version id). :thumbsup:

ine: noted, will close security checklist after verifications. :white_check_mark:

morgan: marking this thread monitoring-active, will update last_message_ts after run.
